tools.name: login_to_whistler
tools.description: Log into Whistler and save the authentication token. No account? Sign up at https://whistler-six.vercel.app/signup.

tools.name: signup_to_whistler
tools.description: Create a new Whistler account in MCP. Alternatively sign up at https://whistler-six.vercel.app/signup. If the email already exists, use login_to_whistler.

tools.name: logout_whistler
tools.description: Log out of Whistler and clear the saved authentication token.

tools.name: get_companies
tools.description: Retrieve companies with optional server-side search, pagination, and eligibility filters. Filters use AND semantics: a company matches only if at least one of its roles satisfies every active filter simultaneously. cpi = student's minimum CPI (0–10); branch = department name (e.g. 'Computer Science'); degree = canonical degree bucket (e.g. 'B.Tech', 'M.Tech', 'Ph.D.'); minCtc/maxCtc = absolute pay amounts in the given currency (e.g. rupees when currency='INR').

cpi.description: Student's CPI (0–10). Returns only companies with at least one role whose CPI cutoff ≤ this value.

minCtc.description: Minimum pay (absolute, in `currency`). Excludes roles whose max pay < this.

maxCtc.description: Maximum pay (absolute, in `currency`). Excludes roles whose min pay > this.

tools.name: search_company
tools.description: Search companies by name, optionally restricted by the same live eligibility filters as get_companies. All active filters use AND semantics on a single role. Returns canonical company IDs with years and role counts. Multiple matches may be returned for ambiguous queries. Zero-match responses may include suggestions.

cpi.description: Student CPI; a role's cutoff must be at or below it.

degree.description: Canonical degree bucket, e.g. B.Tech or M.Tech.

minCtc.description: Minimum pay in the specified currency.

maxCtc.description: Maximum pay in the specified currency.

currency.description: Pay filter currency; defaults to INR.

tools.name: get_company_roles
tools.description: Fetch job role metadata for a company (title, CTC, eligibility, location). Roles include dataQuality flags and consistent numeric CTC/CPI fields. Use year for one season, or years[] for multiple seasons in one call. Call get_role_jd to fetch a role's job description.

tools.name: get_role_jd
tools.description: Get the job description for a single role. Counts toward your daily view limit. Response includes textQuality (clean|noisy_ocr) and cleaned text. If unavailable, includes viewOnWebsite.

tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.description: Submit product feedback (bug, feature idea, or improvement). Keep subject ≤200 chars and message ≤2000 chars. Prefer concise, actionable notes — not long essays.

tools.name: submit_pdf_request
tools.description: Request a one-day boost to the user's JD/PDF daily view limit. Prefer boostAmount (extra PDFs for today, e.g. 10/15/20). Reason should be brief — ideally 1–2 sentences for the admin (max 500 chars; longer text is auto-truncated).

boostAmount.description: Extra PDFs/day to request (preferred), e.g. 10, 15, or 20

reason.description: Brief reason for admin (max 500 chars; longer text is truncated)

tools.name: submit_buy_bid
tools.description: Submit an inquiry or bid to buy the platform.
